summary: This is an 8-K filing reporting preliminary court approval of a derivative settlement. Redwire Corp disclosed that on June 8, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida preliminarily approved a proposed settlement of shareholder derivative actions. The settlement, entered in February 2026, requires Redwire to adopt corporate governance reforms and pay attorneys' fees (expected to be insured), in exchange for release of claims. A final approval hearing is set for July 30, 2026. This is a routine litigation update, not a special situation transaction.
